notes.title: Newbie Level Optimization
notes.content:
Levels Update

Adjusted certain levels in Chapter 1 and Chapter 2 to optimize the gaming experience for new players

notes.title: Chapter 10 - Available Now !
notes.content:
Chapter 10 - Available Now !
New Mechanism

 Stealth Cloak: Upon picking up the Stealth Cloak, the panda becomes invisible to any guards. Stealth mode lasts until any guard is eliminated.

Levels

 10A：20 Levels
 10B：50 Levels
 10C：100+ Random levels
 10D：100+ Random levels

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where a guard might erroneously be triggered for elimination on the second turn of the clock

Achievements

 5 new achievements for Chapter 10
